design.purpose: A drained outdoor planter for herbs or flowers for one gardener, with two planting compartments separated by a removable divider.

steps.c: Lay the wide board flat for cutting.
Cut a 40 cm base; keep the 79.7 cm offcut.
Lay the second board flat for cutting.
Cut front, back and two 16 cm ends.
Lay the narrow board flat for cutting.
Cut a 16 cm divider; keep the offcut.
Sand all cut edges smooth.
Place the 40 cm base flat.
Drill three drainage holes through the base.
Stand the front side on the base front edge.
Stand the back side on the base back edge.
Fit the left end between the sides.
Fit the right end between the sides.
Screw up through the base into the front.
Screw up through the base into the back.
Screw up through the base into the left end.
Screw up through the base into the right end.
Screw through the front into the left end.
Screw through the front into the right end.
Screw through the back into the left end.
Screw through the back into the right end.
Stand the divider across the middle of the base.
